answer: A farm as a result pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The trellis debit happens at intake, ember totals the burned amount, and quill anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 14 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
